id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:step the trace drawer with n and p

review.posthog_relevance: Adds keyboard shortcut support and modal state checks for the trace drawer feature, improving user interaction and accessibility.
review.reason: The chunk is a frontend implementation and test update. P1.F1.H1 adds UI components and a keyboard shortcut utility. P1.F1.H2 adds a test asserting that pressing 'n' or 'p' while a modal is open does not change the trace. P1.F2.H1 adds the useShortcut hook and overlay state check. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and behavior correction.
